_readme: Model presets. load: settings sent when LM Studio loads the model (context_length; LM Studio's own default is small). sampling: request settings for replies with thinking off (fast) and on (think), Qwen3's published recommendations. think_budget: the most reasoning tokens a reply may spend before it is cut off and answered from the notes so far (the composer's Think button turns thinking on; it is off by default because Qwen overthinks).
